rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a yacht used for pleasure trips or racing.

example.english: We rented a yacht to go out to sea on Sunday, and everyone had a great time.
example.traditional: 星期日我哋租咗隻遊艇出海玩，成班人玩得好開心。
